confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from five Palermo price searches. They returned aggregator and guide snippets of mixed dates, such as Expatistan, Livingcost, an Idealista 2025 guide and a 2026 nightlife guide. I discounted clear outliers, such as a roughly $16 mid-range dinner for two and a $4 cappuccino. Euro prices were converted at an approximate EUR/USD rate from general knowledge, not a searched rate. Beer, coffee and the inexpensive meal are best supported. The mid-range meal blends older or undated figures. Cocktail uses a 2026 guide range (spritz about EUR 5-7, cocktails about EUR 6-9). Wine glass uses a EUR 4-6 guide range and the usual local relationship to beer, with no recent direct menu data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge. No live booking pages or listings were inspected, so they carry the most uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Palermo-specific aggregator figures, with no single comparison city. Accommodation assumes southern-Italian tourist-city levels (similar to Naples or Catania, below Rome, Florence and Venice) with a July peak-season uplift, from general knowledge.
